items.originalTitle: Speaking after Alisha clinched the #F1Academy crown, Laurent said... 🗣️ "Alisha has represented our colours superbly and this title is the result ...
items.summaryEn:
Speaking after Alisha clinched the #F1Academy crown, Laurent said... 🗣️
"Alisha has represented our colours superbly and this title is the result of the commitment, determination and professionalism she has shown throughout her journey.
"We are incredibly proud of what Alisha has achieved and look forward to continuing to support her as she takes the next steps in her career."
#RedBullRacing || #USGP 🇺🇸
detailZh:
在Alisha夺得#F1Academy冠军后，Laurent表示... 🗣️
"Alisha出色地代表了我们队的颜色，这个冠军是她在整个旅程中展现出的承诺、决心和专业精神的成果。
"我们对Alisha取得的成就感到无比自豪，并期待继续支持她在职业生涯的下一步。
#RedBullRacing || #USGP 🇺🇸
detailEn:

"Alisha has represented our colours superbly and this title is the result of the commitment, determination and professionalism she has shown throughout her journey.
"We are incredibly proud of what Alisha has achieved and look forward to continuing to support her as she takes the next steps in her career."

items.originalTitle: 🗣️: "I started racing when I was eight or nine years old and it was just me and my parents. "My dad was my mechanic, and my mum came to every sing...
items.summaryEn:
🗣️: "I started racing when I was eight or nine years old and it was just me and my parents. 
"My dad was my mechanic, and my mum came to every single race I’ve ever done. 
"They’ve made so many sacrifices and really put their lives on pause to allow me to live my dream. I’m just so glad to repay them."
#F1Academy || #USGP 🇺🇸
detailZh:
🗣️： "我八岁或九岁开始赛车，那时候只有我和我的父母。 
"我爸爸是我的机械师，我妈妈参加了我所参加的每一场比赛。 
"他们做出了很多牺牲，真的把他们的生活暂停下来，让我能够实现我的梦想。我只是非常高兴能够回报他们。"
detailEn:
🗣️: "I started racing when I was eight or nine years old and it was just me and my parents. 
"My dad was my mechanic, and my mum came to every single race I’ve ever done. 
"They’ve made so many sacrifices and really put their lives on pause to allow me to live my dream. I’m just so glad to repay them."
#F1Academy || #USGP 🇺🇸
